decisions.statement: A relationship is named by its id or by the title its page has.
A relationship reading answers with the ids or with the reasons those ids were refused.
A title with an alias of a relationship tags the stretch with that relationship.
A title and an alias are folded by `page-stem` before either is matched.
An alias more than one relationship has tags the stretch with no relationship.
A relationship a caller names is kept beside a relationship a title tagged.
A relationship is read from the index rather than from the text of its page.

definition: the relationships a stretch of one of Alan's days is tagged with
